review.en: Reviewed source wording for functional meaning, explicit actions, privacy and truthful unavailable/result states.
review.ar: مراجعة نصوص المصدر العربية من حيث المعنى الوظيفي والإجراءات الصريحة والخصوصية وحالات التعذر والنتيجة المؤكدة.
review.runtime_locale_test_status: The pre-completion BIL-06 widget suite ui_fix_005 passed 22/22 cases and the unchanged BASE topic/circle resilience suite ui_resilience_002 passed 16/16. The two completion-delta recovery strings are source-reviewed EN/AR and covered by the final source/static verification inventory; a new Flutter runtime rerun is not claimed by this catalog entry.
review.other_locales: 23 supported locale tags intentionally use English source; NOT_TRANSLATED and NOT_VERIFIED.

extraction.method: Exact local Dart string-pair extraction of every circleManagementText(context, EN, AR) call; identical pairs deduplicated with all references retained.
extraction.coverage: 112/112 resolver call sites extracted (100%); 99 distinct EN/AR pairs.

declaration_excluded.symbol: String circleManagementText(BuildContext context, String en, String ar)

other_copy_dependencies: Unchanged BASE communityText labels such as Retry, Load more, existing circle taxonomy names and membership states remain owned by the existing locale catalogs.

Circle names/descriptions/rules and authorized participant names are server data and are not translated or replaced by stock copy.

placeholder_contract.format: Named {placeholder} in this JSON; retain the listed literal Dart $placeholder at source until native catalog integration.
placeholder_contract.composed_labels: The five composition templates below are source shapes, separate from the 99 translatable pairs. Insert authorized text as plain Flutter text; do not interpret it as HTML, localization keys or navigation.
placeholder_contract.bidi: Use the existing app locale direction. Codes remain exact public identifiers; no user data is inserted into translation keys.
placeholder_contract.counts: No live member/post/invitation count is fabricated by this catalog; existing server-derived counts retain the BASE formatter.
